rules.alternatives: Biennial renewal requires documentation of every current national NP certification from a Board-recognized certifying body; certification lapses if the Board has no record of a current national certification.

topics.who: All health occupation renewal applicants: implicit bias and structural racism training, at the first renewal after April 1, 2026

rules.notes: NP certification expires with the RN license and renews biennially. The Board sets no NP contact hours; the implicit bias/structural racism training (Health Occ. §1-225) is an attestation with no hour count stated. CNS renewal: copy of national certification plus $10.
